card.text: M2 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 11,690 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_7089: Rsun 11.69 ± 0.11 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 2"
sources.quote: Messier 2 or M2 is a globular cluster in the constellation Aquarius, five degrees north of the star Beta Aquarii.

introduction.text: M2 is drawn as 1,209 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
